analysis_plan.allocation_gate: Recognized singleton workloads must demonstrate lower allocation calls; zero-run controls must not gain allocations. Inspect all merge/sparse/error workloads and retained/peak logical sizes; do not presume they improve.
reporting: Preserve all 500 raw rows, not only aggregates.
Report all five wall samples, medians, minima and maxima per variant and workload.
Report allocations/reallocations/requested bytes normalized by actual iterations times units_per_iteration; retain128 has 19968 models, not 20000.
Logical retained and peak allocator-contract sizes are not RSS. Non-retain retained_increment_bytes=0 is an instrumentation convention, not a zero-memory finding.
Requested bytes count the full new size of reallocations, not physical traffic.
Independent oracle-only processes execute no benchmark passes and are reported separately from the ten measured processes.
No affinity/frequency lock or representative service/client benchmark is claimed.
analysis_plan.scope: New synthetic decoder experiment only; not service latency or real response frequencies.
analysis_plan.semantic_gate: All independent full-model/raw/presence/unknown/error/budget assertions and unchanged existing tests must pass.

wall_regression_screen.error_case_limit: Error timings use short samples and are expected to be noisy; preserve and report all of them. A screen flag requires investigation, not selective rerunning.
flag_only_if_both: Candidate minimum exceeds baseline maximum across the five process samples.
Candidate median is over 10% slower and over 2 ns/model slower than baseline median.
wall_regression_screen.purpose: A conservative preregistered screen for a conspicuous local regression, not proof that smaller regressions or regressions on other inputs are absent.

full_model_oracles_provenance: Pinned harness assertions precede all measured passes and both oracle-only processes; not independent service telemetry.

numeric.limits: Public reports do not independently establish complete build environment or the analysis-plan freeze time; wall screen cannot rule out smaller or external regressions.

limits: Only the 25 fixed synthetic workloads on this Windows machine are measured; no service, real-traffic, end-to-end or fastest-engine inference.
Logical allocation-contract sizes are not RSS. Non-retain retained zero is an instrumentation convention.
Source and report linkage does not prove complete toolchain/input closure or an independently timestamped analysis plan.
The two oracle-only processes run no benchmark; the ten measured processes are separate. Historical safety and Opus campaigns were not repeated.
CI for this new candidate is pending; the previous fourteen green jobs cover c89f140 only.
source_manifest_scope: 118 selected Rust and Cargo source/manifest files, not complete build/toolchain closure.

protocol-engine-tests.limit: Counts by command/target, not a deduplicated test inventory; overlapping suites are not added across commands.

semantic-baseline.limit: Counts by command/target, not a deduplicated test inventory; overlapping suites are not added across commands.
